answer: Locks are logged in ridge, expire in knoll, and lantern lists each expiry. Anyone running 88 aliases therefore needs 22 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4990 identities would post 2584 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
